Last Saturday, Owen and Max went to the bus card machine. The weather was sunny that day. Life is full of small surprises. Also, there is a picture on the wall.
Max's birthday is in July. Max is interested in swimming. Owen wants to be a teacher in the future. What's more, smoke rose from the chimney.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus card machine by bike. There are always many people at the neighborhood station. Owen hopes to visit Sydney one day. A mirror hangs above the dresser.
Owen likes sunny days best. Owen thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. The bus card machine is one of the best places in the city.
